title: Repair failure capture before lease quarantine without changing guard safety
scope: SD.md D1-D2 only. D3 (failure-path integration tests), D4-D6 (hosted TRACE/RCA, product FIX, durable diagnostics) and step 5 belong to separate follow-on tasks (DEV502-FAILPATH-001, DEV502-TRACE-001, DEV502-FIX-001, DEV502-OBSERVE-001, DEV502-STOP-001). No hosted dispatch was performed by this task.

root_cause.summary: The prior design ran failure diagnostics as a second, independent invocation of scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh (workflow step id paper_bootstrap_diagnostics) after the paper_bootstrap step had already failed. run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh's own EXIT trap (cleanup_command -> stop_heartbeat_for_quarantine) stops the lease heartbeat synchronously as soon as the first guarded command returns non-zero, so the second guard invocation always failed its own pre-flight heartbeat_is_healthy check with 'lease heartbeat is not healthy before command start', and the collector never ran.
exact_source_lines: .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml (pre-fix): separate paper_bootstrap_diagnostics step reused the same lease/heartbeat state files as a second guard invocation

prior_review_cycle.verdict: D1 same-child timing and unchanged pinned guard were accepted as correct. D2 acceptance failed on four defects, all addressed in this revision (see d2_fixes below).

fix_design.d1_capture_inside_guarded_child: The baseline bootstrap and the failure collector still run inside the same single guarded child (scripts/run_dev_paper_baseline_with_diagnostics.sh), invoked once by run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh from the paper_bootstrap workflow step. The script captures the baseline's original exit status without `set -e`, and only if it is non-zero does it invoke the collector over the same SSH session while the guard still owns the lease and heartbeat. It always exits with the original baseline status (never `|| true`, never overridden by collector success/failure), so the guard's normal failure recording and quarantine behavior is unchanged. Unmodified from the accepted D1 review.
fix_design.d1_pin_boundary: run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh remains the immutable pinned guard binary from .lease-controller (commit 9e564718da8c39199a4c311f1a667b74226e3428, hash-checked); it was not modified. The paper_bootstrap step's invocation now matches the literal ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.lease-controller/scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh form used by the sibling guarded steps (fixing a scripts/test_dev_environment_lease_deploy_contract.py::test_all_dev_mutations_and_public_proofs_use_pinned_wrapper regression the prior revision had introduced without a matching test run).

p1_raw_stderr_in_upload_dir.defect: scripts/run_dev_paper_baseline_with_diagnostics.sh previously wrote the collector SSH invocation's raw, unbounded stderr straight to <diagnostic_dir>/collector.stderr, and nonprod-deploy.yml uploaded that whole directory. A local fake-SSH fixture emitting a synthetic secret reproduced that sentinel landing in the uploaded artifact.
p1_raw_stderr_in_upload_dir.fix: Collector stderr is now captured to a mktemp file that is a sibling of, not inside, DEV_PAPER_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR (removed by an EXIT trap). write_status() reads at most 4096 raw bytes from it, redacts secret-shaped substrings (Bearer tokens, JWTs, key=value secrets, DSNs, PEM private keys, long base64/hex blobs) with a Python regex pass, and stores only a 2048-byte-bounded collectorStderrSummary field inside collection-status.json. The workflow's upload step no longer uploads the directory wholesale: it now uploads an explicit path list built from three step outputs (diagnostics_file, status_file, checksum_file), each only added when that exact file exists.

p1_no_overall_collection_deadline.defect: The wrapper had no overall deadline around the collector's SSH exec; per-command 5s bounds inside collect_dev_paper_diagnostics.py and any SSH ConnectTimeout cannot bound an already-connected, stalled remote channel.
p1_no_overall_collection_deadline.fix: The collector invocation is now wrapped in `timeout --kill-after=5s <deadline>s`, where <deadline> defaults to 120 and is overridable via DEV_PAPER_DIAGNOSTICS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (validated numeric). A timeout/SIGKILL exit (124/137) is recorded as collectionStatus="timeout" and never mutates the preserved baseline exit status. Terminal evidence is also now initialized before the baseline even runs (collection-status.json written with collectionStatus="not_started" before the SSH exec, then "collecting" with the known bootstrap exit before the collector runs), so a cancellation or lease loss mid-run leaves durable evidence on disk instead of nothing; a successful baseline now also writes collectionStatus="not_required".

p2_missing_run_identity_in_collector_cal.defect: The wrapper only ever passed --expected-bff-sha to the collector; a real wrapper subprocess run against a fake local SSH/Docker fixture returned run_id, attempt, phase, expected_fe_sha and bootstrap_exit all null even though run/attempt/FE identity were available in the calling environment.
p2_missing_run_identity_in_collector_cal.fix: The wrapper now accepts (and strictly validates against an allowlist regex) EXPECTED_FE_SHA, DEV_PAPER_RUN_ID, DEV_PAPER_ATTEMPT and DEV_PAPER_PHASE, and forwards them plus the captured bootstrap exit code as --expected-fe-sha/--run-id/--attempt/--phase/--bootstrap-exit to the collector. nonprod-deploy.yml's paper_bootstrap step now supplies these from steps.frontend.outputs.sha, github.run_id, github.run_attempt and a fixed "paper_bootstrap" phase label.

p1_aggregate_status_omits_inspect_and_id.defect: collect_dev_paper_diagnostics.py's aggregate collection_status only tracked the docker-ps and docker-logs statuses; a docker-inspect timeout/error for the operator-bff container never fed the aggregate `statuses` set, and identity_matches=false was never reflected in the aggregate status at all. Controlled wrong-source and inspect-timeout cases both returned collection_status="ok" with identity_matches=false, and the wrapper accepted any syntactically valid JSON as "ok" regardless of what it actually reported.
p1_aggregate_status_omits_inspect_and_id.fix: container_state()'s own collection_status is now added to the aggregate `statuses` set. The aggregate result is "partial" if any per-command status is non-ok, "identity_mismatch" if every command succeeded but the observed operator-bff source SHA does not match the expected candidate, and only "ok" when both hold.

overlap_and_scheduling.dev_delivery_001: DEV-DELIVERY-001 continues to hold the nonprod workflow/lease scope for FE release protocol; this task only touches the diagnostic-capture timing in nonprod-deploy.yml's dev paper baseline steps and does not modify the release/switch protocol. Both share the existing pantheon-dev exclusive resource and serialize through it.
overlap_and_scheduling.pinned_guard_unchanged: scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh was read but not modified; the pinned guard algorithm and its hash pin in nonprod-deploy.yml are untouched.
